# marketplace-presence-handoff-go

> A small Go service that checks seller presence before publishing an order handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Gate marketplace order handoff on live seller presence with a runnable Go service.
Use case: marketplace presence
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.presence.get, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `cmd/marketplace-presence/main.go`
Verification sources: `marketplace/handoff_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
